Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: DPS In Server Bar
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description: Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, boss HP and projected kill time. Includes a live breakdown window, graphs, pull history with comparisons, party DPS checks and an optional FFLogs percentile estimate. Works with ACT (OverlayPlugin WebSocket) or on its own with the built-in tracker.
Changelog:
- Settings > Display: "Preview the server bar" shows placeholder values for 10 seconds, for every element ticked, in their order, with your separator and colors. Changes made meanwhile show up right away.
- Settings > Chat summary: "Preview the chat summary" prints a made-up summary with the values ticked (and an ultimate phase summary when those are on). Only you see it.
- Settings reorganized: new Chat summary tab (everything about the chat summary), Pulls renamed Pulls history, Party checks and Ultimates merged into DPS check. DPS check lists every ultimate, savage raid and extreme trial from the game data, most recent first, with a row ready for each (boss HP, enrage, min pDPS) and a search box; ultimate phases sit under their ultimate. Other zones and single encounters go under "Other / custom".
- Server bar: removed the final value marker (●) and the projected kill time (ETA).
- New look for the settings window: midnight-blue and gold theme, sections in a side menu, titled groups, help icons and highlighted main buttons.
- New look for the main window, same theme: figure cards (your DPS / rDPS, party DPS against the check, boss HP with projected kill, GCD uptime, pace), job icons and role-colored damage bars in the player tables, Kill / Wipe badges and content filter chips in the history, graphs in the theme colors.
